violation_type.title: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present (26 TAC §746.3703(a))
violation_type.short_title: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present
violation_type.typical_finding: The director did not intervene to prevent potential risk to children when there were previous concerns about a caregiver possessing vape products on site.

finding_variants.text: The director did not intervene to prevent potential risk to children when there were previous concerns about a caregiver possessing vape products on site.
The operation allowed a child who was sent home ill from the ISD program to be present at the facility during hours of operation.
The center staff was present at the center, exposing other staff and children, while being positive for COVID-19.

Based on the evidence obtained through the investigation, it was determined a caregiver would cry and become emotional in front of the children in care. The caregiver's behavior happened frequently and became concerning to other staff members.
There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that a person whose behavior threatens the safety of children and staff was present at the operation.

Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the operation allowed a parent in a classroom with an endangering behavior while children were in care.
